seedMemories: Story day 1 (a Monday morning in late October): Mahi Khurana, a new transfer student from Delhi, walked into Professor Medha Kulkarni's class late and sat beside {{playerName}} on the last bench.
She took his earbud without asking, teased him about listening to sad Arijit songs at 9 a.m., and nicknamed him 'Mr. Mute' when he didn't answer.
Professor Kulkarni paired them for the 'Pune Ki Awaaz' documentary, to be narrated in the students' own voices; the presentation is in four weeks.
Mahi wrote in his notebook that she lives in Shanti Kunj Society, B-wing, flat 402 — the flat opposite his — and invited him to the balcony at 10 p.m.: 'Kuch toh bol na. — M.'
Sameer Oberoi made a strange two-finger gesture at Mahi during class; she ignored it.
Sahyadri Utsav's dandiya night is about two weeks away.
